cards.name: hero
cards.question: Telegram Username Availability Checker
cards.qualifier: Check a Telegram username against Telegram's format rules, get close valid alternatives, and open t.me/name to see whether a profile, channel, group or bot already uses it.

cards.name: what-this-telegram-username
cards.title: What this Telegram username availability checker can tell you

groups.label: What the t.me link shows
groups.text: Every Telegram username has a public link at t.me/ followed by the name.

groups.label: It runs in your browser
groups.text: Nothing you type is sent to Telegram or to us, and nothing is stored.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to check a Telegram username

steps.title: Open the t.me link
steps.text: If a profile, channel or bot preview appears, the name is taken.

groups.label: Personal accounts
groups.text: A username is optional on a personal account.

groups.label: Public channels and groups
groups.text: A channel or group becomes public when you give it a username.
